{{Top|leg}}
'''Depthsuits''' were an aquatic-type armor developed for use by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], during the height of the Clone Wars. These black aqua-suits were made from a flexible material that provided each [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] with protection against the intense pressures and temperature changes encountered underwater, allowing them a stealthy access to locations by moving deep underwater
